01 YOUR GENERATIVE AI CURRICULUM

Your GenAI
workshop.
Day by day.

Start with better prompts. Build your way to automation, AI apps and a capstone that puts it all together.

DAYS 01–06Find your foundation.
DAYS 07–10Make it your own.
I’m ready to build ↗

10 days to explore

01GenAI & LLM fundamentalsUnderstand the technology behind the tools

Theory focus

  • AI vs ML vs deep learning
  • Training vs inference
  • Context windows
  • Why hallucinations happen

Hands-on

Compare basic, detailed, role-based and context-rich prompts on the same task, side by side.

Mini challenge

Explain one concept to a 10-year-old, a college student and a CEO.

02Prompt engineering fundamentalsGive AI the right context and a clear task

Theory focus

  • Role, context and task
  • Constraints & output format
  • Zero-shot vs few-shot prompts
  • Delimiters

Hands-on

Write reusable prompts for emails, summaries, research and everyday workplace tasks.

Challenge

Turn a poorly written prompt into a clear, reusable professional prompt.

03Advanced prompt engineeringBuild your personal prompt library

Theory focus

  • Prompt decomposition
  • Iterative refinement
  • Prompt chaining
  • Structured JSON & table output

Hands-on

Take a real problem through tasks, prompting, evaluation, refinement and validation.

Mini project

Create a personal prompt library for learning, coding, content and careers.

04GenAI for productivityPut AI to work in your studies and job

Theory focus

  • Writing & research
  • Analysis & brainstorming
  • Fact-checking & verification
  • Decision support

Hands-on

Students work on notes, resumes and interview preparation. Professionals work on emails, reports and proposals.

Challenge

Turn one raw problem into an email, a summary, a report and a slide outline.

05Multimodal Generative AICreate across text, images, audio and video

Theory focus

  • Text-to-image & image-to-text
  • Text-to-audio & video
  • Multimodal reasoning
  • Image prompting

Hands-on

Shape stronger visuals with the subject, lighting, camera angle, style, mood and aspect ratio.

Mini project

Build a mini campaign with an idea, copy, visual, caption and an AI critique.

06AI automation & no-code workflowsMake an everyday workflow run automatically

Theory focus

  • Trigger, data, AI and action
  • Structured outputs
  • App integrations
  • Automation use cases

Hands-on

Connect a Google Form to a Sheet, run the data through AI and send a personalized email.

Mini project

Build a working automation for certificates, FAQs or lead qualification.

07APIs & your first AI appConnect Python to an LLM API

Theory focus

  • API keys & endpoints
  • Requests, responses & JSON
  • System vs user messages
  • Tokens & parameters

Hands-on

Send user input through Python to an LLM API and handle the response.

Mini project

Build a simple AI chatbot or content generator, end to end.

08RAG & AI with your own dataBuild a chat-with-your-PDF assistant

Theory focus

  • Embeddings
  • Chunking & retrieval
  • Vector search
  • RAG vs fine-tuning

Hands-on

Trace how documents become chunks, embeddings and a vector database that helps generate an answer.

Mini project

Build a basic document Q&A assistant using your own PDFs and data.

09AI agents & responsible AIAdd tools, memory and human oversight

Theory focus

  • Goals & tool calling
  • Memory concepts
  • Bias, privacy & security
  • Prompt injection & review

Hands-on

Design a multi-step agent that researches, summarizes, creates a report and drafts a communication.

Challenge

Identify where human approval and safety checks belong in the workflow.

10Capstone project & live demoBring your own GenAI application to life

Theory focus

  • Use-case framing
  • Solution architecture
  • Evaluation methods
  • Deployment basics

Hands-on

Work in a team of 2–4 to design, build and test an end-to-end Generative AI solution of your choice.

The capstone

Present the problem, solution, workflow, data, output and live demo in 5–7 minutes.

Every day: a concept, a live demo, hands-on practice and a challenge.

05 A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curious?
Good start.

Is this AI upskilling program for me?
EduTantr’s Generative AI (GenAI) workshop is designed for students and working professionals, from beginner to intermediate level. It brings together practical prompt engineering, everyday productivity and building with AI.
Who is the workshop mentor?
Your mentor is Hari Sudhan Chennimalai, Chief Managing Officer & Director at EduTantr. Meet Hari Sudhan and explore his portfolio.
Do I need previous AI experience?
No prior AI experience is required. The first six days build your foundation before you move into Python, APIs, RAG and agents.
How much time should I set aside?
Plan for 2.5–3 hours of live instruction and guided practice each day, across the 10-day workshop.
What will I finish with?
You’ll work in a team of 2–4 to build a Generative AI capstone and present it in a 5–7 minute demo. The six project ideas above are starting points for your own solution.

Before you register.

Key points from EduTantr’s published policies.
The full documents are linked below.

Terms & ConditionsAccount use, learning content and participation
  • Account use: Provide accurate information, protect your login details and use only your own account. Users under 18 need parent or guardian consent where required.
  • Learning materials: Content supports learning and career readiness. Copying, resale, scraping or redistribution requires written permission.
  • Your work: You retain ownership of your submissions. Submitting work permits EduTantr to review, score, display and verify it within the platform and any public portfolio features you enable.
  • Academic honesty: Submissions must be your own. Plagiarism, forged evidence and score manipulation can affect reviews, certificates or account access.
  • Reviews and access: Reviews use published criteria and evidence. Certificates can be revoked if that evidence is invalid. Maintenance and third-party outages may interrupt access.
  • Updates: EduTantr communicates material policy changes through the platform or registered contact details.
Read the full Terms & Conditions ↗
Refund PolicyEligibility, requests and processing times
  • Within 7 calendar days: EduTantr’s published policy allows a full refund if you have completed less than 20% of the program and received neither a mentor-reviewed project approval nor a certificate for that program.
  • After 7 days: Fees are normally non-refundable. Duplicate payments and verified billing errors may qualify for an exception.
  • Delivered services: Completed individual mentor sessions, mock interviews and reviewed submissions are non-refundable as standalone services.
  • Request a refund: Email supportteam@edutantr.in from your registered email with your invoice number, program name and reason. Purchase verification may require more details.
  • Processing: Approved refunds are initiated within 7 working days. Your bank or payment provider may need additional settlement time.
  • Cancellation: Stopping a program does not automatically qualify you for a refund.
